title: EDGAR ingestion: fetch S-1 HTML/PDF + parse node tree (sections, anchors, tables)
description: Implement repeatable ingestion from SEC EDGAR (given CIK/accession). Parse primary HTML into a hierarchical node tree, extract tables with a real HTML parser, persist anchors for citations, and store raw artifacts for caching/debug.

comments.author: Samay Dhawan
comments.text: Shipped sections_manifest.json output (commit 457790c) as a lightweight node tree derived from chunk metadata (section_path -> nested sections, chunk_ids, anchors). Note: fixture content list has no anchors, but EDGAR HTML ingestion should populate them via <a name>/<id>. Next: harden EDGAR ingest (index.json fallback, exhibit/PDF strategy) + improve sectioning using TOC/anchors.

comments.author: Samay Dhawan
comments.text: Added best-effort caching of EDGAR index.json in ingest scripts (ingest:edgar + s1:up) and added a unit test for htmlToContent anchor propagation (commit 6af1098).

comments.author: Samay Dhawan
comments.text: Closing scope: EDGAR HTML ingestion + cached raw artifacts (index.html/index.json/primary HTML), anchor-aware content_list.json, table parsing, and sections_manifest.json shipped. Follow-ups: mastra-stanley-e3c (index.json-driven doc selection + exhibits) and mastra-stanley-d82 (PDF/page citations).

title: DevEx: add one-command S-1 up script
description: Add npm script that ingests an S-1 from EDGAR, processes chunks/tables, generates embeddings, and launches mastra dev with the active filingId.

title: Fix chunk explosion bug in semantic splitting
description: splitTextAtSemanticBoundaries() continued emitting near-duplicate tail chunks when endPos==text.length, causing tens of thousands of chunks for a single filing. Add a termination condition when we consume to end.
close_reason: Fixed in code: stop emitting tail overlap chunks in splitTextAtSemanticBoundaries().

title: Table parsing v2: handle rowspan/colspan + header detection
description: S1Processor still parses element.table_body via regex (src/processor/S1Processor.ts). Replace with cheerio-based HTML table matrix extraction that supports rowspan/colspan, header row detection, and produces a stable markdown/text_view for retrieval + exact citations via anchor/source_url.
close_reason: Implemented cheerio table matrix parsing + basic header/data-start detection; surfaced structure in tables_manifest and table reader.

title: S-1 chunking v2: typed chunks + parent/child context + citation anchors
description: Replace fixed char chunking with S-1-aware chunking: paragraph chunks, risk-factor chunks, MD&A chunks, and table row-group chunks. Preserve hierarchy (section_path) and stable anchors (HTML id / page label) for citations. Add parent/child retrieval support.
notes:
Progress: fixed semantic splitter tail duplication (mastra-stanley-1ud) and added section-aware chunk_type + avoid mixing anchors inside a chunk (commit f1a6946). Next: risk-factor/MD&A substructure + parent/child context + token budgeting.
Progress: added TOC detection+skipping, safer major-heading heuristics, prev/next chunk pointers in metadata, and readS1ChunkContext tool for neighbor context.

comments.author: Samay Dhawan
comments.text: Shipped chunking improvements: default pre-major content grouped under 'Cover Page'; chunk content now includes a short preamble (major + leaf headings) so split chunks retain section context; fixed a bug where chunk.metadata.section_path could be mutated by later heading parsing (now cloned in createChunk) + added regression test (commit 8fd2ed3).

comments.author: Samay Dhawan
comments.text: Hardened heading detection: removed overly-broad MAJOR_HEADING match on any text containing 'FINANCIAL STATEMENTS' (now only MD&A uses includes(); financial statements require explicit short heading) and added boilerplate header/footer line skipping (repeated SEC/S-1 patterns) to reduce noisy section resets (commit 000ae03).

title: Deep scrub + S-1 ingestion/retrieval spec
description: Deeply review current repo (ingestion -> chunking -> embeddings -> retrieval -> Mastra agents/workflows) and write an S-1-specific spec + implementation plan to make it reliable, high-quality (no slop), and 10x more performant. Include chunking strategy, table handling, citations, eval harness, and Mastra best practices.
notes: Drafted spec + plans: docs/S1_AGENT_SPEC.md, docs/RETRIEVAL_ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/EVALUATION.md.

comments.author: Samay Dhawan
comments.text: Goal: allow page-accurate citations when HTML anchors are insufficient. Approach: fetch filing PDF (if available) or render HTML -> PDF; extract text with page numbers; map chunks/facts back to page spans; expose citations as (pdf_url#page=N) or local artifact links. Keep optional behind flag to avoid slowing default flow.

title: EDGAR ingestion v2: parse index.json + ingest exhibits + docs manifest

comments.author: Samay Dhawan
comments.text: Scope: Use EDGAR index.json as a primary source of truth for file listing/selection; persist a docs manifest (documents[] + selected primary) under output/filings/<filingId>/raw/; optionally ingest high-value exhibits (e.g., EX-99, EX-10.*) behind a flag; keep one-filing UX. Non-goals: PDF/page citations (separate issue).

title: Upgrade Mastra + dependency hygiene (pin versions, adopt new APIs, remove 'latest')
description: Upgrade to current Mastra release. Pin dependency versions (remove 'latest'), update APIs (e.g., requestContext vs runtimeContext if applicable), and replace bespoke vector query tools with Mastra RAG primitives where it helps. Ensure scripts still run.

comments.author: Samay Dhawan
comments.text: Pinned previously-'latest' deps to installed versions to improve reproducibility: @ai-sdk/openai@1.3.22, @mastra/pg@0.12.1, @mastra/rag@1.0.1 (commit 368bf81). Remaining: decide whether to upgrade Mastra core/memory, and audit/update APIs + consider swapping bespoke tools for Mastra RAG primitives.

title: Evaluation harness: add eval/queries.jsonl + retrieval/answer benchmarks + CI gates
description: Implement the evaluation plan in docs/EVALUATION.md: create query suite JSONL, add npm scripts for eval:retrieval and eval:answers, collect latency/cost metrics, and add CI-friendly gates to prevent slop regressions.

comments.author: Samay Dhawan
comments.text: Implemented eval harness + seeded query suite: added eval/queries.jsonl, scripts npm run eval:retrieval (BM25-based, writes eval/results/*-retrieval.json) and npm run eval:answers (workflow-based, citation/no-slop gates, writes eval/results/*-answers.json). Added eval results dir to .gitignore and fixed s1QueryWorkflow section filter to avoid brittle section_path equality filtering (commit 9537134). Remaining: wire CI gates (optional) and tune thresholds/expected sections based on real filings.

title: Hybrid retrieval v2: Postgres FTS + pgvector ranking + section/type priors
description: Move keyword scoring from in-memory BM25 to Postgres full-text search (tsvector) and combine with pgvector similarity. Implement a single hybrid retrieval tool that supports filing_id filters, section/type priors, and query-time knobs (HNSW ef / IVF probes).

title: De-Figma: make pipeline filing-agnostic (filing_id, config, no hard-coded counts/values)
description: Remove Figma-specific assumptions across prompts, IDs, heuristics, and scripts. Introduce filing_id everywhere (chunks, embeddings, tools). Replace hard-coded chunk/table counts with computed values.
close_reason: Removed Figma-specific assumptions from runtime code; pipeline is filing_id-scoped and table tooling no longer hard-codes fixture table counts.

title: Facts layer: extract and store structured S-1 facts (financials, offering terms, ownership)
description: Add a fact schema/store and implement extractors for: (1) financial statement line items (revenue, gross profit, opex, net loss, cash), (2) offering terms (price range, primary vs secondary shares, greenshoe, proceeds), (3) beneficial ownership (5% holders, voting power, dual-class). Every fact must have evidence (chunk/table anchor + quote).
notes: Implemented facts framework: per-filing facts.json, deterministic financial/offering extractors with evidence, facts lookup tool, and s1:up now runs fact extraction. Ownership extractor still TODO (needs cleaner table examples + robust column mapping).
close_reason: Implemented facts.json store + deterministic extractors for financial metrics, offering terms, and ownership (incl. 5% holder + voting power), plus lookupS1Facts tool.

title: Fix test script (jest missing)
description: package.json defines "test": "jest" but jest is not installed. Decide: add a lightweight test runner (node:test or vitest/jest) OR remove/replace the script; add at least one smoke test for chunking + table parsing.
close_reason: Replaced jest with node:test smoke tests (chunking + table parsing).
